about.title: About us
about.subtitle: An Egyptian travel company running day trips and multi-day journeys across Egypt.
about.story: We started with a single trip and a small group of friends. Today we run regular journeys to Egypt's most rewarding destinations. What hasn't changed is the method: plan every detail in advance, choose comfortable transport, and leave our guests free to enjoy the place instead of worrying about logistics.
